name: kernel-iac-production
description: Production infrastructure as code for kernel IAC

scripts.terraform-apply-flag-management: cd teams/kernel/iac/production && terraform plan -out=tfplan -var-file=env.tfvars && terraform apply -auto-approve -target='module.production[0].module.kernel-flag-management[0]'
scripts.terraform-apply: cd teams/kernel/iac/production && terraform apply -auto-approve tfplan && terraform output
scripts.terraform-graph: cd teams/kernel/iac/production && terraform graph | dot -Tsvg > graph.svg
